Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent arcade fighting-game victory sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: Monteiro victory sequence, exactly SIX frames in THREE columns and TWO rows. Input image 2 is the identity/costume reference for the REPLACEMENT defeated opponent.
Primary request: Remove the generic black-and-purple enemy from EVERY frame. Replace ONLY that enemy with Kalliane, woman with long wavy blonde hair, black tracksuit with vivid magenta trim, white undershirt, black fingerless gloves, badge on blue lanyard, white/black/magenta sneakers.
Preserve Monteiro standing on the LEFT in every frame, his precise identity, brown dreadlocks, headphones, olive vest, white shirt, jeans, boots, poses and green Ethernet cable. Use the kneeling loser on the RIGHT, head inclined, alive and conscious, showing a tired resigned defeat. No gore, no injury detail, no distress or choking; the cable is a loose comic arcade loop sitting around the neck/collar with visible space, not tightened.
Preserve the exact six-frame action sequence reading left-to-right, then next row: 1 winner holds coiled cable, 2 winner raises loose cable loop, 3 winner places loose loop over kneeling opponent's collar, 4 winner holds cable loosely, 5 winner raises fist, 6 final fist-up celebration hold. Opponent must be the same referenced character in all six frames, never the purple enemy. Match the reference face, hair, body, clothes and color scheme. Preserve all winner/cable actions and relative placement.
Layout: THREE columns by TWO rows, six complete two-person cutouts, 1536 by 1024 canvas. Keep each entire pair including all hair, raised hands and both characters' shoes WITHIN its own 512 by 512 cell, centered horizontally, feet touching a common baseline at y=480 within each cell. Leave at least 20 pixels of clear margin on all sides, no overlap between neighboring frames or rows. Consistent body scale across six frames. Actual transparent alpha background, no scenery, no dark backdrop, no ground shadows, no labels, no borders. Same detailed crisp 1990s arcade sprite illustration as image 1. No extra people, no missing limbs, no duplicated body parts.
